description: Is this package safe to install? One call, one verdict: safe / caution / avoid, with a score, concrete reasons (known vulnerabilities from OSV, deprecation, abandonment, adoption, install scripts, typosquat signals) and a one-line recommendation. Input: name, ecosystem (npm | PyPI), optional version. Free over MCP (100/day shared quota); unlimited via x402 at https://tolca.tonbot.ca/v1/pkg-check ($0.02).
name: pkg_check
title: Package safety check (npm / PyPI)
